labels.rationale: Manually audited at the pin: libraryPaths is projected at line 90 as length > 0, but hasConfiguredLibrary enters the callback body at 698 and 703 and its dependency array at 731. Array length and callback lifetime/snapshot analysis are outside the strict scalar-equality subset. This is research, not a safe migration claim.

Manually audited selectors at lines 67 and 85 already return booleans for playing and selected state. They are negative controls for a new projection recommendation; their helper/property/optional branches are not evidence for widening the supported expression subset.

Manually audited at the pin: activeDropZone is read only in `activeDropZone === id`, the pattern the reorder-controls package fixed upstream. Here DragDropProvider subscribes to activeDropZone$ and builds a fresh context value on every render, so each hover change re-renders every zone through useDragDrop and a boolean selector removes no render. The rule abstains because the context value is not mount-stable; it becomes actionable once the provider stops subscribing and memoizes its value.

Manually audited at the pin: draggedItem is read only in `draggedItem !== null`, and a drag-enter replaces one dragged object with another, which re-renders every zone for an unchanged boolean. The same useDragDrop context blocker applies, so the projection stays research until the provider value is mount-stable.
